jp: USEMSG1:ゴシゴシ　ゴシゴシ…
EAT:(2)は￥ｎといしを口によせた…
en: EAT:(2) brought the Whetstone￥ｎto their mouth...

jp: EAT_OK:(2)はといしを￥ｎ口に入れてなめた(B)ペロペロ…(B)歯がピカピカになった
en: EAT_OK:(2) put the Whetstone￥ｎin their mouth and licked it.(B)Lick lick...(B)Your teeth are sparkling!

jp: EAT_NG:(2)はといしを￥ｎ口に入れてなめた(B)ペロペロ…(B)途中で気分が悪くなった
en: EAT_NG:(2) put the Whetstone￥ｎin their mouth and licked it.(B)Lick lick...(B)You started feeling sick.
